coverage_arithmetic.rule: Tested coverage is the count of categories with current active CLI wiring, deterministic evidence, and required negative controls. not_applicable is excluded and separately reported; blocked, inconclusive, and not_tested never increase tested coverage. Full/compliant OWASP claims require all ten categories to meet the active evidence contract and are not allowed by this Phase 2A matrix.
